items.docs:
Pushes a snapshot to an organization.
**Required privileges:**
- `Snapshot - Edit` in both organizations.
- `View` in the original organization on all [domains](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2819/) targeted by the snapshot.

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"SNAPSHOTS","type":"EDIT","targetId":"*"} ```

params.name: snapshotId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target snapshot.
**Example:** `startingorganization-xzgbf5rdaiqtaznvh74zdwcedi`

params.name: deleteMissingResources
params.description:
Whether to simulate the deletion of organization resources not present in the snapshot.
**Default:** `false`

params.name: deletionScope
params.description:
**Note:** only applies when `deleteMissingResources` is set to `true`.
The scope of the resources on which to calculate deletions.
**Default:** `ONLY_TYPES_FROM_SNAPSHOT`

params.name: performAutoSynchronization
params.description:
Whether to automatically synchronize resources in the snapshot with corresponding organization resources.
**Default:** `true`

params.name: autoSynchronizationThreshold
params.description:
If autoSynchronization is set to true, this score controls how lenient the pairing of values will be.
The value should be set to 1.00 or lower. A value of 1 will require an exact match for synchronization of fields.

params.name: includeChildrenResources
params.description:
Whether to include child resources in the snapshot.
For example, when creating a snapshot of a query pipeline resource, if the `includeChildrenResources` parameter is set to true, the [pipeline's statements](https://docs.coveo.com/en/236/) will be included in the snapshot.
**Default:** `true`

items.docs:
Creates a snapshot of an organization and optionally sends it to another organization.
**Required privileges:**
- `Snapshot - Edit`
- `View` on all domains corresponding to the resources to include in the snapshot.
- If exporting to another organization, you also need `Snapshot - Edit` privilege in that target organization.

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"SNAPSHOTS","type":"CREATE","targetId":"*"} ```

params.description:

**Possible values:**
- `JSON`: the configuration is in one single JSON file.
- `ZIP`: the configuration is separated into several JSON files, each containing one or more resources, without overlap between files

- `ALL`: all reports.
**Default:** `SUMMARY`

info.name: Create URL to Retrieve Snapshot Content

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `startingorganizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: snapshotId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target snapshot.
**Example:** `startingorganization-xzgbf5rdaiqtaznvh74zdwcedi`

params.name: contentType
params.description:
The version of the snapshot to show.
**Possible values:**
- `PRIMARY`: The actual snapshot content.
- `CURRENT_STATE`: The resources targeted by the snapshot as they were in the target organization itself at the moment of the last dry run operation. This is useful to compare with the actual snapshot content (`PRIMARY`) before applying it.
**Default:** `PRIMARY`

- `View` on all domains corresponding to the resources included in the snapshot

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"SNAPSHOTS","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
